# Rakitsu tested build: v0.3.2 (09c37a8e)
name: Code change risk review
version: "1.0"
description: Identify risks in a proposed change and have a second agent turn them into checks a reviewer can run.
settings:
  default_provider: ollama
  providers:
    ollama:
      type: ollama
      base_url: http://127.0.0.1:11434/v1
      default_model: qwen3:4b-q4_K_M
  defaults:
    temperature: 0
    max_tokens: 1400
agents:
  - name: Inspector
    role: worker
    system_prompt: Identify the most important regression in the proposed change. Use only the supplied facts.
    settings: { max_iterations: 1 }
  - name: Verifier
    role: worker
    system_prompt: Review the risk against the original change. Under a heading called Review verdict, describe the authorization regression and propose one concrete unauthorized-access test. Do not claim to have executed it.
    settings: { max_iterations: 1 }
orchestrator:
  name: Recipe
  strategy: Pipeline
  agents: [Inspector, Verifier]
  pipeline:
    steps:
      - name: inspector
        agent: Inspector
        task: Identify the most important regression in the proposed change. Use only the supplied facts. /no_think
      - name: verifier
        agent: Verifier
        task: Review the risk against the original change. Under a heading called Review verdict, describe the authorization regression and propose one concrete unauthorized-access test. Do not claim to have executed it. /no_think
